skillset.skill: 22s CT - 4000% Fire DMG (MAG). Increase own Arts by 100.
skillset.arts:
For 20s, increase Human allies' Arts by 4/s, Skill CT Speed by 100%, and heal Human allies' HP by 2%/s.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type I and will not stack with other Type I Arts Gen.
skillset.truearts: 75000% Fire DMG (MAG). For 30s, increase allies' ATK and DEF by 100%.

passive.ability1: Increase Fire and Water allies' MAG DMG by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [2% x own ATK and DEF/ 100].

trueweapon.name: Emotion Igniter
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 10000% Fire DMG (MAG). For 10s, increase own MAG DMG by 50%. Additionally if user is Fire, for 10s, increase own ATK by 50%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Summer Lotte & Valerie, increase own ATK by 30% and Arts by 150 at Start of Quest. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
